description: Run this FIRST when the user says "Set up Fundz", "get me started", asks what you can do for them end to end, or before the first outreach email in a conversation. It returns the user's sender profile and what is missing from it, their plan and target titles, and a checklist of what each workflow needs (send email, see replies, see booked meetings, log to a CRM, run follow-ups on a schedule). You then compare that checklist with the tools you ACTUALLY have in this chat: a connector can be connected to the account and still be switched off in this chat, so trust your own tool list, not what the user remembers connecting. Tell the user plainly what they can and cannot do today and the exact fix for each gap. It also returns the rules for sending from the user's mailbox (no links in the email body, the mailbox signature carries links, the Gmail "--" line setting) and the one-prompt setup order: profile, ICP, test email to the user's own address, first small batch, follow-up task. When the account is new (profile or targeting mostly empty) the result gives a short interview to run in plain words, one question at a time, saving each answer with update_targeting_preferences and save_sender_profile, so the user is fully set up without opening Fundz. Reads only; sends nothing.
